Specification: This specification models a very small two-variable state machine over integer variables x and y. The initial state sets x to 0 and y to 1, and the single step action Next swaps the values of x and y on every transition. The module focuses on testing the behavior of formulas that mix temporal operators with boolean connectives, and it defines one liveness formula intended to hold and another variant that differs by the polarity of a nested temporal condition.
